title: Contraction bound |γ(w, ·)| ≤ √(k+1)·‖w‖·|γ| for the Euclidean coefficient norm
statement: Let p, k ∈ ℕ, let γ be a (k+1)-covector on ℝ^p (γ : Covector (Eucl p) (k+1), a continuous alternating (k+1)-linear map (ℝ^p)^{k+1} → ℝ), let w ∈ ℝ^p, and let δ be a k-covector on ℝ^p (δ : Covector (Eucl p) k) with δ(u) = γ(Fin.cons w u) = γ(w, u_1, …, u_k) for every u : Fin k → ℝ^p. Then |δ| ≤ √(k+1)·‖w‖·|γ|. Here |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm, the Euclidean norm of the coefficients α(e_{I(1)}, …, e_{I(n)}) over strictly increasing index tuples I (e = standard basis of ℝ^p, EuclideanSpace.basisFun), and ‖w‖ is the Euclidean norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (p k : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl p) (k + 1)) (w : Eucl p) (δ : Covector (Eucl p) k), (∀ u : Fin k → Eucl p, δ u = γ (Fin.cons w u)) → covectorEuclideanNorm δ ≤ Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖w‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm γ
